semanticBoundary.guardFalsePath: A matching pattern may evaluate its guard, consume an affine owner, then reject the arm. Later arms must inherit that possible MOVE.
semanticBoundary.patternSkippedPath: A nonmatching pattern skips its guard. A join may conservatively retain the move when either path can reach the next arm.
semanticBoundary.branchBodyIsolation: Only the successful arm executes its body; body-only MOVE may not poison a disjoint fallback, provided the earlier body exits or the join handles its continuing path.
semanticBoundary.ownershipCheck: Compiler-owned checked AST/HIR/MIR, before executable object/IR publication, not host-only parser admission.
semanticBoundary.noThreadIdentity: OS carrier thread identity cannot grant ownership or undo a move.

limitations: Source blob locations are reference metadata only; no private source text is replicated into the conformance repository.
A draft Java compiler check exists in PR #2691, but no exact-head JUnit or Graal guest has executed.
Compilation, code generation, native AOT and actual guest runtime results for the other backends remain NOT_EXECUTED.
The manifest is not an executable ownership oracle and cannot authenticate CI receipts.
